title: Study Sync
description: MERN-based group study application with real-time chat, file sharing, and notifications.
impact: Integrated AWS S3 for file storage and Socket.io for live messaging.
summary: Built a collaborative study hub with real-time collaboration and scalable file delivery.

title: MiniChess
description: A 5x6 MiniChess engine featuring alpha-beta pruning, move ordering, and quiescence search.
impact: Implemented transposition tables for faster decision-making and efficient evaluation.
summary: Designed an AI engine optimized for tactical depth and fast evaluation.

title: Garments Inventory System
description: Backend system for inventory, orders, product management, and role-based access.
impact: Session-based auth with Redis, raw SQL optimization, Dockerized, and Jest-tested APIs.
summary: Operational backend for inventory and order workflows with secure access control.

title: CodeBlog API
description: RESTful blogging API with authentication, posts, and comments management.
impact: Package-by-feature structure with layered services and secure controllers.
summary: Modular API with clean separation of auth, posts, and comments.
